description: This module manages Security Group Rule on Scaleway account https://developer.scaleway.com.

parameters.name: api_timeout
parameters.description: HTTP timeout to Scaleway API in seconds. Default: 30

parameters.name: api_token
parameters.description: Scaleway OAuth token. This is required if profile is not specified.

parameters.name: ip_range
parameters.description: IPV4 CIDR notation to apply to the rule. Default: "0.0.0.0/0"

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: Port related to the rule, null value for all the ports.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: The config profile in config file to load the Scaleway OAuth token from, use instead of api_token. It is also possible to set SCW_PROFILE to use a SCW CLI config profile.

parameters.name: query_parameters
parameters.description: List of parameters passed to the query string. Default: {}

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Scaleway region to use (for example par1). Choices: "ams1" "EMEA-NL-EVS" "ams2" "ams3" "par1" "EMEA-FR-PAR1" "par2" "EMEA-FR-PAR2" "par3" "waw1" "EMEA-PL-WAW1" "waw2" "waw3"

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Indicate desired state of the Security Group Rule. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Validate SSL certs of the Scaleway API. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Create a Security Group Rule
  community.general.scaleway_security_group_rule:
    state: present
    region: par1
    protocol: TCP
    port: 80
    ip_range: 0.0.0.0/0
    direction: inbound
    action: accept
    security_group: b57210ee-1281-4820-a6db-329f78596ecb
  register: security_group_rule_creation_task

return_values.name: data
return_values.description: This is only present when state=present. Returned: when state=present Sample: {"scaleway_security_group_rule": {"action": "accept", "dest_port_from": 80, "dest_port_to": null, "direction": "inbound", "editable": null, "id": "10cb0b9a-80f6-4830-abd7-a31cd828b5e9", "ip_range": "0.0.0.0/0", "position": 2, "protocol": "TCP"}}
